4693-5531-6621-8345.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4693-5531-6621-8345.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Repeat.

4186-4279-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-5931.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

3755-4222-8230.easyPrerequisites: Seedship Agrarian doesn't have summoning sickness.
3755-4222-8230.description:
Activate Seedship Agrarian by tapping it, adding {U}.
Seedship Agrarian triggers, creating a Lander token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Seedship Agrarian.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4927-5078-5243-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2896-4247-5145.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

728-1414-2866-4986.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-5902-7061.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Innkeeper's Talent and Solid Ground.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

240-2034-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2034-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

141-2511-7364.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2511-7364.description:
Cast Continue? by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Continue?.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Continue?
Resolve the Continue? copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2511-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to three additional creatures and return them using Continue? each loop.

3532-5078-6259-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-6259-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

3259-4460-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1374-3626-5499-6968--24.notablePrerequisites:
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1374-3626-5499-6968--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

2275-3532-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Shabraz triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-3499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Squirrel by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

11-3528-3942-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-3528-3942-6276.description:
Cast Rise of the Eldrazi by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Rise of the Eldrazi.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Rise of the Eldrazi, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Rise of the Eldrazi, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3528-3942-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Karador this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

4616-5231-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
4616-5231-6249--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Repeat.

1669-2438-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4152-4321-5856.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4152-4321-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Undercity Scrounger's ability by tapping it, creating a Food and Treasure token.
Repeat.

1349-1999-2034-2793-3088.manaNeeded: {1}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U} available each extra turn
1349-1999-2034-2793-3088.notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter and Xenic Poltergeist do not have summoning sickness.
1349-1999-2034-2793-3088.description:
Activate Xenic Poltergeist by tapping it, causing Ugin's Nexus to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
At the beginning of your end step, Athreos' second ability triggers, putting a coin counter on Ugin's Nexus.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus, adding {C}{C}.
Ugin's Nexus is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Athreos' third ability triggers, causing you to return Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Ugin's Nexus to your hand, choosing to not put an artifact onto the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat.

1369-3995-5112-5116.notablePrerequisites: Mairsil does not have summoning sickness.
1369-3995-5112-5116.description:
Activate Mairsil using Gilded Lotus' ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mairsil using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Activate Mairsil using Quicksilver Elemental's ability by paying {U}, causing it to gain all activated abilities of itself until end of turn.
Repeat.
If desired, you may use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities using Mairsil, and then use Quicksilver Elemental's ability to use them infinitely.

1432-1753-2661.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{W} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or to activate abilities of creatures..
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Samut and Gwenna.
Repeat.

618-1799-2034-4725.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Swiftgear Drake.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Swiftgear Drake.
When the Swiftgear Drake token enters the batlefield, it triggers, putting Kiki-Jiki on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Kiki-Jiki into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1887-4050-4577-5046.notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least one reprieve counter.
1887-4050-4577-5046.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Martyr for the Cause, adding one mana of any color.
Martyr for the Cause dies, triggering itself and Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Martyr for the Cause trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting two reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Resolve the Magnanimous Magistrate trigger, causing you to remove two reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Martyr for the Cause from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1992-4381-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
1992-4381-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with at least one +1/+1 counter.
Basri's Lieutenant trigger, creating a 2/2 Knight token.
When Knight token enters the battlefield, Grumgully triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Knight token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
